description: BLAS-like kernels (base/blas.rs): tr_dot, axpy, axcpy, gemv, gemv_tr, sygemv, ger, syger, gemm, gemm_tr, quadform, quadform_tr on a sample of the static shapes

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: matrix2x3_tr_dot
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_quadform
ops.tolerance: ceil(3 + 1 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix3_quadform_tr
ops.tolerance: ceil(3 + 1 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
